rounds.text: The Sun and its ruling planet share a name, radiating warmth, life, and true self-expression. Often shown with a child, symbolizing purity, creativity, and optimism, this card brings fortune and {b2} drawn from authentic identity rather than performance. As the pulsing heart of the whole system, the Sun offers vital {b1}, but with a caution: get too close and you can be burned, so avoid centering everything on yourself.
